summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the ESC ]0;title BEL formatting entry and Control.title(title) with a docstring; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) after show_cursor, returning True only when the console is a terminal, with the required docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title) once; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Not run: per instructions, no tests, Black, or repository code were executed, and nothing was committed. Formatting was checked by reading only.
